定位.完整句: As illustrated in Figure 1 and Table S2, the DMPU has a high DN of 34.0 kcal mol−1 and a dipole moment (μ) of 4.23 D, which is much higher than that of conventional ether solvents (DME and DOL) and the five-membered cyclic urea (N, N′-dimethylethyleneurea, DMEU).

This was ascribed to the weak electron donicity and low dipole moment (μ) of DOL (DN: 17.5 kcal mol−1, μ: 1.19 D) and DME (DN: 20.0 kcal mol−1, μ: 1.72 D), which exhibits moderately solvating ability with LiPSs, resulting in low solubility of LiPSs and sluggish S redox kinetics with unfavorable 2D Li2S deposition (Figures 1a and S1).

DMEU, a cyclic solvent with a high DN of 29.0 kcal mol−1 and a high μ of 4.09 D, can significantly enhance the solvation of LiPSs and trigger the S3 •−-based conversion pathway with 3D Li2S deposition morphology (Figure 1b).
